why: #48146's Storage on This Mac action is App-only wiring: it resolves the local acpmux through QuitAgents.environment, supplies the AppActionContext window, and binds the CmuxNextServer popover. The storage card, strings, report and daemon calls remain in CmuxNextServer/CmuxNextAgentPane; no lower target can hold these AppServices and window closures. Independent review covers these unchanged eight composition lines only; it is not a whole-PR or CI verdict.
